name: re-engagement
description: Designs re-engagement for dormant leads and inactive customers: win-back sequences, reactivation offers, and sunset policies that protect deliverability. Use when the user wants to revive a cold database, win back churned or inactive customers, or decide when to stop mailing unengaged contacts. Triggers on: "re-engagement", "win-back", "reactivation", "dormant leads", "inactive customers", "sunset policy".
